title: Removal probe
blurb: Checks 'createDTMFSender' in RTCPeerConnection.prototype (WPT historical.html?interop-2026) and invokes pc.createDTMFSender(track) on a live WebRTC loopback beside standard RTCRtpSender.dtmf.
question: Is RTCPeerConnection.prototype.createDTMFSender still exposed in this browser, and when present does it return the identical RTCDTMFSender instance as RTCRtpSender.dtmf?
result: In Chrome 153 headless, createDTMFSender is still present and calling it on a negotiated loopback returns an RTCDTMFSender strictly equal (===) to sender.dtmf. The removed TypeError branch requires Chrome 160+ (no preview flag exists).
testedIn: Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12; Chrome 160 removal branch not verified in Chrome 160

friction.summary: No chrome://flags switch or Blink runtime flag exists to preview createDTMFSender removal ahead of Chrome 160
friction.repro: Inspect Chromium runtime_enabled_features.json5 (checked 2026-11-22); no DTMF removal opt-in flag is exposed for pre-160 testing, only a server-side Finch kill switch.
friction.workaround: Use the Migration shim page's in-tab prototype deletion toggle to test legacy code against the Chrome 160 TypeError path before upgrading.
